sentences.text: Gerard James Butler -LRB- born 13 November 1969 -RRB- is a Scottish actor who has appeared on film , stage , and television .

After studying law , Butler turned to acting in the mid-1990s with small roles in productions such as Mrs Brown -LRB- 1997 -RRB- , the James Bond film Tomorrow Never Dies -LRB- 1997 -RRB- , and Tale of the Mummy -LRB- 1998 -RRB- .
